message_text_english: There are no Pokémon in the party or Battle Box.
trigger_condition: slot is empty (no Pokemon stored there)
notes: shown as 'no Pokemon' only when no slot holds a Pokemon (inference)

message_text_english: OK
trigger_condition: no problem found for this Pokemon

message_text_english: There is a Bad Egg in the party or the Battle Box.
trigger_condition: Bad Egg: the Bad Egg flag (sanity word bit 2) is set, or the stored checksum does not match the data

message_text_english: Invalid Pokémon: Pokémon No. value is out of range.
trigger_condition: species number is 0 or above 649

message_text_english: This Pokémon hasn't been distributed yet.
trigger_condition: message exists; no return site found in the BW2 code path

message_text_english: There is no shiny version of this Pokémon.
trigger_condition: species is shiny-locked (flag 0x0002) and the Pokemon is shiny

message_text_english: Ineligible Pokémon.
trigger_condition: species flag 0x80 (mode 4) / 0x100 (mode 1) / 0x200 (mode 2). The BW2 tool always uses mode 0, so never evaluated
notes: semantics verified by calling the checker with mode 1

message_text_english: Level outside of 1 to 100.
trigger_condition: level is not in 1..100 (mode != 4)
notes: tested via a party-form record with level 0 and 101

message_text_english: This Pokémon can't be obtained at this level.
trigger_condition: level is below the species' minimum legal level (record+2)

message_text_english: This Pokémon's form No. is invalid.
trigger_condition: form number is above the species' maximum form (record+3, signed)

message_text_english: Limited distribution Pokémon, but flag isn't set.
trigger_condition: species flag 0x0004 (limited distribution) and the event/fateful flag is not set

message_text_english: Illegal Pokémon is in a ball it shouldn't be in.
trigger_condition: ball ID is outside 1..25

message_text_english: This Pokémon must be in an ordinary Poké Ball.
trigger_condition: species flag 0x0010 requires an ordinary Poke Ball (ID 4) and the ball is different

message_text_english: Pokémon hatched from an Egg must be in a Poké Ball.
trigger_condition: egg location is set (hatched) and the ball is not a Poke Ball (ID 4)

message_text_english: Pokémon has illegal Ability
trigger_condition: ability is not one of the species' abilities (with exceptions for a few form species)

message_text_english: This Pokémon's has an unobtainable held item.
trigger_condition: held item ID above 625, or the item's bit is clear in rule.prd's 80-byte item whitelist (mode 0 also rejects item 225)

message_text_english: This Pokémon can't be found with this Ability yet.
trigger_condition: species flag 0x0400 and the ability is the species' Hidden Ability
notes: the BW1-era template sets 0x0400 on 645/649 species; rule_bw2.prd clears it by default

message_text_english: Illegal Ability/gender pairing for this Pokémon.
trigger_condition: species flag 0x1000 with Hidden Ability and gender field 0x6E non-zero
notes: no species carries flag 0x1000 in the compiled-in table

message_text_english: This Pokémon can't be used so please change Pokémon.
trigger_condition: species bit set in the banned-species bitmap (bytes 0x12-0x63)
notes: accessor verified in emulator; only evaluated if the Pokemon passed every rule.prd check

message_text_english: Holding an unusable item, please change items.
trigger_condition: held item bit set in the banned-item bitmap (bytes 0x64-0xB3)
notes: accessor verified in emulator

message_text_english: Lv violates tournament rules. Change Pokémon.
trigger_condition: level rule: mode (byte 0x0D) 1 = level must be >= byte 0x0C, mode 2 = level must be <= byte 0x0C
notes: accessor verified in emulator

message_text_english: Can't have two of the same Pokémon. Change Pokémon.
trigger_condition: two Pokemon of the same species (skipped when byte 0x10 is non-zero)
notes: party/box-wide; accessor verified. The LOG stores bit 0x02 (viewer shows 2)

message_text_english: Another Pokémon has the same item. Change items.
trigger_condition: two Pokemon holding the same item (skipped when byte 0x11 is non-zero)
notes: party/box-wide; accessor verified. The LOG stores bit 0x04 (viewer shows 4)

message_text_english: Total Lv exceeds regulation Please change Pokémon.
trigger_condition: sum of levels above the cap (u16 at 0x0E; 0 = no cap)
notes: party/box-wide; accessor verified. The LOG stores bit 0x08 (viewer shows 8)

message_text_english: Check number of Pokémon. Too few for the battle.
trigger_condition: fewer Pokemon than the minimum (byte 0x0A)
notes: party/box-wide; accessor verified; CONFIRMED ON REAL HARDWARE (2-Pokemon Battle Box logged value 16). The LOG stores bit 0x10 (viewer shows 16)
